# Faith Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 or 12 years old  <sub>[v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P1](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0001), [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried child living with her family  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c20 P0](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Faith is a young girl of noticeable spirit whose vibrant looks depend heavily on her colour. When healthy and animated, she has bright crimson cheeks, though she can appear pale, meek, or insignificant when frightened or upset. She possesses golden hair and companionable blue eyes.

_Sources: [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Faith is a high-spirited, impulsive, and affectionate girl who reacts strongly to emotion and injustice. Though quick to act without thinking—which sometimes lands her in embarrassing situations or trouble—she harbors deep compassion for animals and friends alike. She possesses a fiery temper when insulted, but is comforted easily by warm sympathy and genuine understanding. Extremely devoted to her father, she cares deeply about defending his reputation and family honor.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000), [v5 c5 P12](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0012), [v5 c16 P49](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0049), [v5 c19 P0](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0000), [v5 c20 P38](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0038), [v5 c20 P40](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0040), [v5 c25 P18](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0018), [v5 c25 P24](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0024)_

## History

Faith grew up at the manse alongside her siblings Jerry, Una, and Carl, enjoying unstructured freedom while missing out on basic domestic training. One Saturday morning, she and her siblings discovered the runaway orphan Mary Vance hiding in Mr. Taylor's old barn and brought her home to feed her. During a house-cleaning endeavor with Una, she accidentally caused a local scandal by shaking house rugs in the old graveyard on Sunday morning. When her cherished pet rooster Adam was slaughtered by Aunt Martha for a visiting minister's dinner, a grief-stricken Faith refused to eat and sought comfort from Rosemary West in Rainbow Valley, forming a close friendship with her. Deeply concerned about her father's parish duties, Faith personally confronted Norman Douglas at his home to ask him to return to church and contribute to the minister's salary, only to be verbally berated and insulted by him. Later, after going to church barefoot due to a lack of intact stockings and facing heavy public criticism, she served a week-long punishment assigned by the Good-Conduct Club by wearing striped stockings to school. To clear her father of any public blame for the incident, she wrote a detailed explanatory letter that was published on the front page of the local newspaper.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P3](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0003), [v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 c5 P23](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0023), [v5 c10 P38](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0038), [v5 c10 P43](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0043), [v5 c15 P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038), [v5 c16 P28](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0028), [v5 c16 P39](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0039), [v5 c16 P48](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0048), [v5 c19 P0](../source/v05-c19.md#nw-v05-c19-p0000), [v5 c20 P17](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0017), [v5 c20 P38](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0038), [v5 c25 P18](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0018), [v5 c25 P22](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0022), [v5 c25 P24](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0024), [v5 c25 P25](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0025), [v5 c25 P27](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0027)_
